body.statement:
Fix \((P,B^0,\varepsilon,\pi_0)\in\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{pub}}\), and let \(\mathcal O_G\) be its observed moments for an arbitrary view graph \(G\).  Then \(\operatorname{Enum}_G(\mathcal O_G)\) emits exactly \(\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)=\{T_\pi:\pi\in\mathfrak S_V\}\), each numerical tuple once, and computes \(\mathcal A_G(\mathcal O_G)\).  In the ordered exact-real model \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{ER}}\), full-lattice construction and pruning, exact lexicographic row interning, integer-fragment trie propagation, decoding, output, and common-ancestry intersection require \(O(\operatorname{poly}(p,m)2^p\max\{1,N_{\mathrm{out}}\})\) total time and space.  An explicit time bound is
\[
 O\!\left(mp^3 2^p+p^3 2^pN_{\mathrm{out}}+mp^2N_{\mathrm{out}}\right).
\]
No hash oracle on real numbers, no cross-view residual zero test, and no traversal of all \(p!\) orders is used.
body.proof_tex:
For every \(A\subseteq V\), induction on \(|A|\) exactly as in (14) gives
\[
 H_A=\{F(\rho):\rho\text{ is a full-lattice prefix ending at }A\}.
 \tag{17}
\]
Merging equal fragments is complete and preserves every continuation by
\(\texttt{lem:live-fragment-right-congruence}\).  At \(A=V\), no row is
unassigned.  By \(\texttt{lem:original-row-invariance}\), the decoded sink
fragment of a permutation \(\pi\) is exactly \(T_\pi\).  By
\(\texttt{thm:published-all-orders-covariance-compatible}\), all and only
the permutations in the full lattice belong to
\(\Pi_G(\mathcal O_G)\).  Therefore
\[
 \{\text{decoded members of }H_V\}
 =\{T_\pi:\pi\in\mathfrak S_V\}
 =\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G).
 \tag{18}
\]
For a fixed original row label, lexicographic sorting compares all
exact-real coordinates and gives equal rows the same integer identifier.
Trie insertion creates a terminal only for the first occurrence of an
integer vector.  Equation (18) is consequently emitted without omission and
with every numerical tuple emitted once.

We now count operations in \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{ER}}\).  The full removed-set
lattice has \(2^p\) vertices and \(p2^{p-1}\) edges.  Every vertex lies on
a source-to-sink path, so forward and backward pruning retain all vertices
and cost \(O(p2^p)\).  For fixed \(A\) and view \(a\), one dense
factorization of \(\Sigma^{aa}[A,A]\), followed by solving all rows indexed
by \(V\setminus A\), computes every \(\beta^{(a)}(A,r)\) leaving \(A\) in
\(O(p^3)\) field operations.  The inverse exists by
\(\texttt{lem:original-row-invariance}\).  Over all subsets and views this
costs
\[
 O(mp^3 2^p).
 \tag{19}
\]

For a fixed row label \(r\), exactly \(K_r=2^{p-1}\) lattice edges carry
that label.  Comparing two viewwise rows lexicographically examines at most
\(mp\) exact-real entries.  Comparison sorting and adjacent equality
interning therefore cost
\[
 O\!\left(mp\sum_{r\in V}K_r\log(K_r+1)\right)
 =O(mp^3 2^p),
 \tag{20}
\]
because \(\log_2(K_r+1)=O(p)\).  This is deterministic and uses no
real-valued hash.

Each row identifier uses \(O(p)\) bits, and a fragment has \(p\) identifier
slots.  Lookup or insertion in a deterministic binary trie therefore costs
\(O(p^2)\) bit or pointer operations.  By
\(\texttt{lem:projection-output-bound}\), at most
\(p2^pN_{\mathrm{out}}\) transitions are attempted, so propagation costs
\[
 O(p^3 2^pN_{\mathrm{out}}).
 \tag{21}
\]
Decoding \(m\) matrices with \(p^2\) entries for each output costs
\(O(mp^2N_{\mathrm{out}})\).  The ancestry computation from
\(\texttt{prop:common-union-support-ancestry}\) adds
\(O(N_{\mathrm{out}}(mp^2+p^3))\), which is absorbed by (21) and the
decoding term because \(p,m\ge2\).  Adding (19)--(21) gives the explicit
time bound in the statement.

For space, the interned rows occupy \(O(mp^2 2^p)\) real cells.  The tries
occupy \(O(p^2 2^pN_{\mathrm{out}})\) bits or pointers by
\(\sum_A|H_A|\le2^pN_{\mathrm{out}}\), and retained decoded outputs occupy
\(O(mp^2N_{\mathrm{out}})\) cells; the ancestry accumulator uses only
\(O(p^2)\) additional bits.  The full-lattice edge list costs
\(O(p2^p)\).  Since the output set is nonempty by
\(\texttt{thm:published-all-orders-covariance-compatible}\), these time and
space bounds are
\[
 O\!\left(\operatorname{poly}(p,m)2^p
 \max\{1,N_{\mathrm{out}}\}\right).
\]
Every propagation loop ranges over a retained fragment and an outgoing
subset edge.  None ranges over permutations, and no cross-view residual
entry is used to screen an order.
body.justification: This replacement theorem supplies the exact-once full-lattice coefficient frontier, output-sensitive accounting, and common ancestry in one coherent result.
body.gap: Existing enumeration methods neither identify the unrestricted-cross-view covariance boundary nor quotient all \(p!\) marginal orders by equality of numerical LiMVAM coefficient tuples.
body.consumer: The PairwiseLiMVAM and DirectLiMVAM workflow can report every exact population coefficient mechanism before applying the inherited covariance-region uncertainty layer.
